_comment: Hand-authored places absent from the upstream dataset.
Upstream (Tear -> theMountainGoat -> cadaei, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0) is the source
of record for everything else; this file is our own editorial addition and
is merged in by scripts/prepare-data.mjs. Keep it small and justify each
entry — the map's authority rests on not inventing things.
Coordinates are in the upstream system (roughly African latitudes, chosen
by cadaei to keep Mercator distortion sane). Verify any new point falls
inside both the landmass and its intended region before committing.

places.name: Casterly Rock
places.note: Seat of House Lannister, absent from the source dataset. Placed on the coast north of Lannisport, the harbour city the Rock stands above. Position is approximate.

places.name: High Tide
places.note: Seat of House Velaryon on Driftmark, built by the Sea Snake. The source dataset predates House of the Dragon and has no Driftmark settlements; placed on the island's north coast, above the water. Position is approximate.

places.name: Spicetown
places.note: Velaryon port on Driftmark, raised on the wealth of the Sea Snake's voyages and later sacked. Absent from the source dataset; placed on the island's western end. Position is approximate.

places.name: Hull
places.note: The elder of Driftmark's two ports. Absent from the source dataset; placed on the island's eastern end, apart from Spicetown. Position is approximate.
